text:
sam: Huge shoutout to ops and events — jules & diego pulled an all-nighter to move the demo gear and rewire the AV. customer call saved :tada:
jules: wow that felt like a live action puzzle. literally dragging a rack through the stairwell at 11:30pm :sweat_smile:
maria: also massive thanks to diego for running snack logistics on zero notice. curry and cookies are a morale miracle :heart:
diego: I only accept bribes in cookies and good coffee. plant survived the journey too 🌱
alex: That was some cross-team choreography. Ops + Events + Eng = dream team :raised_hands:
sam: @jules @diego I just sent you both a couple of coffee vouchers via DM — tiny token but well earned :coffee:
jules: <@sam> absolute legend. also shoutout to @dev-bot for the last-minute hotfix that kept the demo from failing :robot_face:
dev-bot: deploy: patch/demo-stability v1.0.3 applied at 2026-03-22T23:12:03Z — no rollbacks triggered ✅
riley: I'm going to add a quick kudos entry to the team wiki so this doesn't vanish into Slack history. will draft a PR in #docs in a bit
maria: please do — we should highlight who moved the rack so we can nominate them for the service award :clap:
sam: micro-poll time: next all-hands snacks — pizza 🍕 or empanadas 🫔? reply with emoji
maria: :pizza:
diego: :empanada:
riley: pizza wins 2-1 — pizza it is :pizza:
alex: also, can we get a hero snack box delivered to the Ops floor tomorrow? small thank-you from the whole company
sam: done. ordering now. thanks again everyone — you made a tense call feel effortless. seriously grateful :star:
